description: To the payload corresponding JSON schema file is `oAuth2AccessTokenAuthorizationGrant.json`

grant_type.description: OAuth 2.0 **grant_type** `authorization_code`, to generate an access token

code.description: same code as it was generated from the authorization server as part of the authorization response call

redirect_uri.description: same URI as it was submitted to the authorization server as part of the authorization request call

client_id.description: generic id, may be needed in dependence of the established client authorization with the authorization server
